name: WF2: ShipBob Tracking → Shopify Fulfillment Sync

nodes.name: ShipBob Webhook (Optional)
nodes.notes: Optional: If your ShipBob plan supports webhooks, point shipment_shipped events to this URL. Otherwise, the cron trigger handles everything.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ fulfillment: { location_id: $env.SHOPIFY_LOCATION_ID, tracking_number: $json.tracking_number, tracking_urls: [$json.tracking_url], tracking_company: $json.carrier, line_items: $json.line_item_ids.map(id => ({ id })), notify_customer: true } }) }}

parameters.subject: =[n8n ERROR] Tracking sync failed for order {{ $('Skip if Already Fulfilled').first().json.order_name }}
